name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A native checkbox whose tick pops in and draws itself, an indeterminate dash and three sizes. CSS-only motion.

.rx-checkbox.transition: background-color 200ms var(--motion-ease), border-color 200ms var(--motion-ease), box-shadow 200ms var(--motion-ease), scale var(--spring-press-duration) var(--spring-press)

.rx-checkbox-mark.transition: opacity 160ms var(--motion-ease), scale 160ms var(--motion-ease), filter 160ms var(--motion-ease)

.rx-checkbox:has(> :checked:not(:indeter.transition: opacity calc(var(--spring-check-duration) * 0.5) var(--spring-check), scale calc(var(--spring-check-duration) * 0.5) var(--spring-check), filter calc(var(--spring-check-duration) * 0.5) var(--spring-check)
